description.text: Objectives: Students aim to qualify themselves as senior experts who can solve practical problems with means of mathematics and computer technology based on the theory and technique they learn in the field of Mathematics. 1. Performing scientific research in an economics field; 2. Engaging quantitative analysis in finance and economic management fields using economic models; 3. Seeking a career in the field of Education and Administration Management. Object: Four-year Bachelor of Science Degree Main courses: Analytics, Algebra, Geometry, Differential Equation, Probability Theory, Statistics for Engineers, Applied Stochastic Processes, Discrete Mathematics, Mathematical Modeling/Experimentation, Operational Research, Mathematics Models & Applications, Fundamentals of Applied Computer, Economics.

duration.text: The Mathematics and Applied Mathematics at Nanjing Audit University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 3or above 4. Academic transcript of high school 5. Graduation certificate of high school Gradution certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not,it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.

requirements.text: Applicant is under the age of 25, and is in good health, high-school graduate with good marks. The HSK score should reach level 3 or above
